html: שׂדה (√ of foll., meaning unknown; foll. plausibly connected with Assyrian šadû, mountain, used by people whose land was mountainous (cf. Ju 5:18 Dt 32:13 +), by JPPetersJBL xii (1893), 54 f. and (simultan.) BAES (1893), 65 f. cf. WklAltor. Forsch. ii. (1894), 192; JägerBAS ii. 282 cp. Assyrian šedtum, pasture-land; TelAm. (Canaan. gloss) šatê WklTelAm. 180, 56; Ph. שד = BH, NH = BH, so Ecclus 40:22).
